A small student idea, growing with every order.
More than a store

Made by students,
for students.

Student Kart is a student-led startup built around a simple idea: useful, trendy products should feel easier to shop for. We bring together selected bags, skincare and beauty essentials at prices that respect a student budget.

We are starting small, learning from our customers and building the store one good find at a time.
